title: EcoRank: Budget-Constrained Text Re-ranking Using Large Language Models

layout.note: Two ranking boxes in a row, one on a blue half and one on a yellow half of the background, with three dashed-frame list columns (initial, intermediate, final) before, between and after them; the query sits top left and a long arrow along the top edge carries it to the second box; the budget coins sit at the boundary of the halves.

lesson: Redraw one small list after every stage and recolour its items by what the stage decided, so a reader sees the effect of each layer without a text example; put a coin on every arrow that costs budget.
